title: The Creator's Lab — Advanced Projects and Experiments
description: Test your knowledge of DNA, crystals, animation, maps, chemical reactions, and architecture — and the Creator behind it all!

questions.question: What is the shape of the DNA molecule called?
questions.explanation: DNA has a double helix shape — like a twisted ladder. This elegant structure was designed by God to store the incredibly complex instructions for building living organisms.

questions.question: In DNA, adenine (A) always pairs with which base?
questions.explanation: Adenine always pairs with thymine (A-T), and cytosine always pairs with guanine (C-G). This precise pairing system ensures accurate copying of genetic information.

questions.question: What causes crystals to grow in orderly geometric shapes?
options: The repeating pattern of atoms in a crystal lattice
questions.explanation: Crystals grow in geometric shapes because their atoms arrange themselves in a highly ordered, repeating pattern called a crystal lattice — reflecting the order God built into creation.

questions.question: How many photographs might be needed for a 30-second stop-motion animation?
questions.explanation: A 30-second stop-motion animation played at 10 frames per second would need at least 300 individual photographs, each showing a tiny movement — teaching us the value of patience and detailed work.

questions.question: On a topographic map, what do closely spaced contour lines indicate?
questions.explanation: When contour lines are close together, it means the elevation changes rapidly over a short distance — indicating steep terrain like a cliff or mountainside.

questions.question: Which of the following is a sign that a chemical reaction has occurred?
options: The substance stays exactly the same
A color change, gas production, or temperature change
The substance gets bigger without changing
The substance moves to a different container
questions.explanation: Chemical reactions produce observable signs including color changes, gas bubbles, temperature changes, precipitate formation, or light production — evidence that new substances are being formed.

questions.question: According to Jesus' parable, what should we build our lives upon?
questions.explanation: In Matthew 7:24-27, Jesus taught that the wise person builds on the rock — meaning God's Word. Just as buildings need strong foundations, our lives need the solid foundation of Scripture.

questions.question: Why is the triangle considered the strongest shape in structural engineering?
options: It cannot be deformed without breaking a side
questions.explanation: A triangle is rigid because its shape cannot be changed without breaking one of its sides. This makes it the strongest shape for building — a principle God built into the laws of physics.
